claims.text: Semantic density extracts uncertainty and confidence information for each LLM response from a probability distribution perspective in semantic space.
Semantic density has no restriction on task types.
Semantic density is off-the-shelf for new models and tasks without requiring additional training.

evidence.description: Semantic density extracts uncertainty/confidence information for each response from a probability distribution perspective in semantic space.
It has no restriction on task types.
It is 'off-the-shelf' for new models and tasks.

methodologies.name: Semantic density
methodologies.description: A framework that quantifies LLM response uncertainty and confidence from a probability distribution perspective within semantic space.

limitations.text: Prior uncertainty quantification methods for LLMs are restricted to classification tasks.
Prior uncertainty quantification methods for LLMs require additional training and data.
Prior uncertainty quantification methods consider only lexical instead of semantic information.
Prior uncertainty quantification methods are prompt-wise but not response-wise.
